description: SurrealDB must be the primary data store for all activity data (templates, metrics, executions). Redis is a read-through cache only. Write path: Client → rpc-api → SurrealDB → Redis cache. Read path: Client → rpc-api → Redis (cache hit) OR SurrealDB (cache miss) → populate Redis.

currentImplementation.summary: Dual-write pattern exists but Redis is still the primary storage for templates. SurrealDB is primary for executions.
currentImplementation.details: Template operations (create/read/update) go to Redis first. Execution results use a dual-write pattern with compensating transactions (Redis first, then SurrealDB). Activity data storage uses SurrealDB directly.

components.currentBehavior: Writes template to Redis ONLY. No SurrealDB write. Uses keys: activity:template:{variant_id}, activity:metrics:{variant_id}, activity:templates:list
components.desiredBehavior: Write to SurrealDB first, then populate Redis cache with TTL
components.gap: Missing SurrealDB write operation. Need to call db.operations.template_data.create_template_record()

components.currentBehavior: Reads from Redis ONLY. Uses redis.smembers('activity:templates:list') and redis.get(f'activity:template:{template_id}')
components.desiredBehavior: Try Redis cache first, on miss query SurrealDB and populate cache
components.gap: No fallback to SurrealDB on cache miss. Need cache-aside pattern implementation

components.desiredBehavior: Try Redis cache first, on miss query SurrealDB and populate cache
components.gap: No fallback to SurrealDB on cache miss

components.currentBehavior: DUAL-WRITE with compensating transaction: Updates Redis metrics atomically (WATCH/MULTI/EXEC), then writes to SurrealDB (insert_execution + update_metrics_after_execution). On SurrealDB failure, rolls back Redis to snapshot.
components.desiredBehavior: Write to SurrealDB first, then invalidate/update Redis cache
components.gap: Order is reversed - Redis updated before SurrealDB. Should be: SurrealDB write → Redis cache update/invalidation

components.currentBehavior: Reads Thompson sampling metrics from Redis ONLY. Increments selection count in Redis.
components.desiredBehavior: Read from SurrealDB (primary), cache results in Redis for fast Thompson sampling
components.gap: No SurrealDB read. Thompson sampling needs to be fast, so cache is critical but must be backed by SurrealDB

components.currentBehavior: Writes to SurrealDB first (primary), then dual-writes to Redis for caching (lines 100-122). Redis failure is non-fatal.
components.desiredBehavior: This is CORRECT pattern - SurrealDB primary, Redis cache secondary
components.gap: NONE - this component follows the specification correctly

components.currentBehavior: Writes metrics to SurrealDB ONLY. No Redis cache update.
components.desiredBehavior: Write to SurrealDB first, then update Redis cache with TTL
components.gap: Missing Redis cache update after SurrealDB write

components.currentBehavior: Reads from SurrealDB ONLY via query: SELECT * FROM template_metrics WHERE variant_id = $variant_id
components.desiredBehavior: Try Redis cache first, on miss query SurrealDB and populate cache
components.gap: No Redis cache layer. Should implement cache-aside pattern

components.currentBehavior: Writes execution record to Redis ONLY. Uses hash keys: execution:{activity_id}
components.desiredBehavior: This service appears to be separate/legacy. Should delegate to activity_execution.insert_execution()
components.gap: Duplicate logic. Should be refactored to use SurrealDB-backed operations

components.currentBehavior: Reads from Redis, aggregates, writes back to Redis ONLY
components.desiredBehavior: Should use template_metrics operations which write to SurrealDB
components.gap: Bypasses SurrealDB entirely. Legacy/duplicate code path

templateCreation.desired: Client → POST /v2/activities/templates → create_template() → SurrealDB → Redis cache (TTL)

templateRead.desired: Client → GET /v2/activities/templates/{id} → get_template_by_id() → Redis (hit) OR SurrealDB (miss) → populate Redis
templateRead.gap: No cache-aside pattern, no SurrealDB fallback

executionRecording.current: Client → POST /v2/activities/executions → record_execution_result() → Redis (atomic) → SurrealDB (dual-write) → rollback Redis on failure
executionRecording.desired: Client → POST /v2/activities/executions → record_execution_result() → SurrealDB → Redis cache invalidation/update
executionRecording.gap: Order is reversed. SurrealDB should be written first, not second

metricsUpdate.current: record_execution_result() → insert_execution(SurrealDB) + update_metrics_after_execution(SurrealDB) → no Redis update
metricsUpdate.desired: record_execution_result() → SurrealDB updates → Redis cache invalidation for affected metrics

thompsonSampling.desired: Client → POST /v2/activities/templates/{id}/select → select_variant_thompson_sampling() → SurrealDB metrics → cache in Redis → Beta sampling
thompsonSampling.gap: No SurrealDB read, no cache population

architecturalIssues.impact: Templates are not persisted durably. Redis data loss = complete template loss.
Redis updated before SurrealDB in record_execution_result(). Cache can be ahead of source of truth during failures.
SurrealDB updates don't invalidate Redis cache. Stale cache possible.
Parallel code path that writes to Redis only, creating consistency issues

phase1.title: Template Storage Migration
tasks: Create template_data table in SurrealDB schema
Update create_template() to write SurrealDB first, then Redis cache
Update list_templates() to implement cache-aside pattern
Update get_template_by_id() to implement cache-aside pattern
Add Redis TTL configuration (suggest 1 hour for templates)

phase2.title: Execution Recording Fix
tasks: Reverse order in record_execution_result(): SurrealDB first, Redis cache second
Remove compensating transaction (no longer needed with correct order)
Add cache invalidation for metrics after SurrealDB updates

phase3.title: Thompson Sampling Cache Optimization
tasks: Update select_variant_thompson_sampling() to read from SurrealDB
Cache Thompson sampling metrics in Redis with short TTL (5 minutes)
Ensure cache invalidation on metric updates
Performance test Thompson sampling with cache-aside pattern

phase4.title: Deprecate Legacy Metrics Aggregator
tasks: Migrate callers to use activity_execution and template_metrics operations
Remove or refactor MetricsAggregator to delegate to SurrealDB operations
Verify no direct Redis writes remain outside cache layer

scenarios.name: Template Persistence

scenarios.name: Cache-Aside Read
scenarios.test: Read template (miss), verify SurrealDB query, verify Redis population, read again (hit)

scenarios.name: Execution Recording Order
scenarios.test: Record execution with SurrealDB failure, verify Redis NOT updated

scenarios.name: Cache Invalidation
scenarios.test: Update metrics in SurrealDB, verify Redis cache invalidated or updated

scenarios.name: Thompson Sampling Correctness
scenarios.test: Select variant with fresh cache vs stale cache, verify metrics fetched from SurrealDB
